resources.string: Recovery shows each muscle right now: red when just worked or locked because you said it is still sore, amber while it recovers, green when ready, grey if you have not trained it this week. This week compares your sets with the 10–20 weekly sets that build muscle (15 = 100%). It comes from your logged sets and your watch\'s workouts, and it is an estimate.
%1$d sets this week (%2$d%% of the weekly target).
Locked until %1$s because you said it is still sore.
Sore and stiff: easy movement, heat and good sleep help most. Ice only for sharp pain or swelling in the first two days. If the pain is strong or does not ease in a few days, see a professional.
You have %1$s planned today, but it is only %2$d%% recovered. Train another group or swap it for something lighter.
%1$s recovered and can be trained again.
Still sore: rest %1$d h more before training it
